posts.description: Before we found camping in Odda, we came across this beauty of a waterfall-Latefossen. -J 🇳🇴

We’ve had many technical challenges with posting during our trip (and we’ve been taking a ton of photos of this gorgeous country!) We appreciate your patience :) We’ll try to keep posting when we can, but the vast majority of the posts will likely be posted upon return. Cheers! -J 🇳🇴
We also stopped at the Roldov Stave Church. You can really see the wooden pins used instead of nails. -J🇳🇴
